label: tab:cohort-partitions
caption: Patient partitions and machine-complete citation mappings before analysis-specific eligibility filters.

label: tab:rq2-flow
caption: Sequential inclusion for correct-proposal coverage and Tree-rule comparisons. Incorrect proposals remain in separate sensitivity analyses.

label: tab:trace-partitions
caption: TRACE partitions. App./Chol./Div./Panc. denote appendicitis, cholecystitis, diverticulitis and pancreatitis. Each test admission has a distinct inferred subject.

label: tab:rerun-config
caption: Configurations for the fitted sources, probes and text processing.

label: tab:reviewer-set-agreement
caption: Citation-set agreement. Dice, Jaccard and identical counts compare reviewers. The last two columns compare automatic mapping with each reviewer's policy set: micro precision/recall agreement (percent), not mapping accuracy. Neither reviewer is a gold standard.

label: tab:mapping-flips
caption: Four-combination mapping sensitivity. Cells give remaining failures (recovered/newly failing); all counts are rationales. C/I denote conservative/inclusive policies. Samples overlap by one rationale and are not pooled.

label: tab:targeted-policy-ap
caption: Targeted-audit policy sensitivity on the same 53 rationales (32 patients). Entries are descriptive AP differences: local positive-SHAP coverage minus each comparator; no significance claim is attached. C/I denote conservative/inclusive policies. Failure counts appear in Table~\ref{tab:mapping-flips}; Tree-probe comparisons involve Tree-source self-evaluation.

label: tab:absolute-recovery
caption: Absolute reference-diagnosis recovery (\%). R/T denote Representation/Tree. Panel A gives correct/evaluable admissions or patients before full-input correctness filtering. DDXPlus $H$ contains age and sex; TRACE $H$ is empty. Panel B uses correct proposals and both-full-correct records, and gives both explanation-weighted and unit-averaged recovery. Panel C averages within patient/admission before averaging across units. All results use frozen predictors.

label: tab:rq1-both-full-correct
caption: DDXPlus primary evidence-selection gains: 50 matched controls at 25\% and ten at 50/75\%. Patient-paired 95\% intervals are unadjusted. R/T denote Representation/Tree probes; * marks self-evaluation. Group-enhanced shares the Representation backbone. Gains are relative to each selector's own fact-count-matched random control, not paired differences between selectors.

label: tab:trace-selection-contrasts
caption: TRACE direct accuracy contrasts at 25\% (percentage points), mean admission-level selection Jaccard and identical-set percentage. Overlap describes one fitted-model comparison, not repeat-fit stability.

label: tab:trace-rq1-all
caption: TRACE all-test sensitivity at 25\%: available admissions and matched-control gains [95\% CI]. Availability is evaluated within each comparison family. Gains use 50 controls; $^{10}$ marks complete comparison families retaining ten because additional controls contain unseen Representation states.

label: tab:natural-core
caption: Natural-rationale failure AP [95\% CI] for correct proposals. All rows use 1,979 rationales/889 patients; Representation and Tree probes have 20 and 39 failures. $^{*}$: self-evaluation; Group-enhanced shares the Representation backbone.

label: tab:trace-natural
caption: TRACE natural-rationale failure AP [95\% CI], correct proposals: 614 explanations from 210 admissions, with 105 Representation and 44 Tree failures. *: self-evaluation. Fact and group coverage coincide because feature groups are singletons.

label: tab:trace-natural-sensitivity
caption: TRACE reference-recovery sensitivities. Scores continue to target the proposed diagnosis. Including partial exact mappings changes eligibility, rather than applying human corrections. Upper panel: descriptive AP on common records. Lower panel: paired AP differences with 95\% inferred-subject bootstrap intervals, unadjusted for multiple comparisons. R/T denote Representation/Tree probes; Tree-source scores under T involve self-evaluation.

label: tab:controlled-core
caption: Controlled-set patient-averaged concordance (\%) [95\% CI]. Common sets at 25/50/75\%: 11,641/12,397/10,224. The Representation probe contributes 835, 225 and 36 patients. Tree self-evaluation is omitted; fixed-count fact coverage equals 50\%, and Tree $R$ has identical within-patient ordering to $A$.

label: tab:trace-controlled-contrasts
caption: TRACE paired controlled contrasts. Concordance differences are percentage points; referenced-support differences use AP units. Intervals are marginal and unadjusted; R/T denote Representation/Tree. Tree-source comparisons under T involve self-evaluation. Positive concordance favors the first named score. $R$ and $A$ have the same fixed-admission, fixed-diagnosis ordering.

label: tab:version-support-contrasts
caption: Fixed-diagnosis evidence-version comparisons under the Representation probe. Panel A gives local positive-SHAP minus comparator concordance (percentage points) for correct proposals and nonzero support differences. Panel B additionally requires both versions to recover the reference diagnosis and a target-support gap of at least 0.01; it reports SHAP concordance (percent) and paired differences (points). Brackets give 95\% intervals. Populations differ between panels. Higher support for an incorrect proposal is not clinical improvement.

label: tab:adjudicated-quality
caption: Automatic citation mapping against complete adjudicated references. Complete/reviewed counts describe explanations; units are patients or admissions. Precision, recall and F1 pool facts within each stratum. DDXPlus strata overlap by one explanation.

label: tab:adjudicated-contrasts
caption: Adjudicated-reference sensitivity for correct proposals under Representation. Assoc., Local and Group denote Association, local positive-SHAP and uniform group coverage; $A$ is Tree direct support. Fixed retains automatic outcomes; Updated recomputes them. Intervals are simultaneous 95\% intervals for the Updated contrast, adjusted across three comparisons within each stratum. Counts are explanations/patients or admissions.

label: tab:role-census
caption: Premise roles in the reviewed explanations. Opposing refers to the first-ranked diagnosis. The final column counts negative/normal citations with stated argumentative use. Random and targeted strata are reported separately.

label: tab:role-contrasts
caption: Role sensitivity for correct proposals under Representation. Entries are AP differences; Related and Support include simultaneous 95\% intervals with recomputed outcomes. Counts are explanations/patients or admissions. Assoc., Local and Group denote Association, local positive-SHAP and uniform group coverage; $A$ is Tree direct support.

label: tab:simultaneous-contrasts
caption: Core contrasts and 95\% bootstrap intervals. RQ2 reports AP differences multiplied by 100; RQ3 reports concordance percentage points. Original and new marginal columns use 1,000 and 5,000 draws, respectively. The last column adjusts within each three-row family. Assoc./Local/Group denote coverage; $A$ is Tree direct support. RQ2 uses 1,979 explanations/889 patients (DDXPlus) and 614/210 admissions (TRACE). RQ3 $n$ counts units contributing discordant pairs.

label: tab:ap-prevalence-reference
caption: AP relative to failure prevalence for correct proposals under Representation. The common populations contain 20/1,979 failures in DDXPlus ($\pi=0.0101$) and 105/614 in TRACE ($\pi=0.1710$). Lift is a descriptive ratio, not an accuracy improvement.

label: tab:aligned-endpoints
caption: Descriptive AP under two endpoints, using the Representation probe and complete mappings. Within each dataset/stratum, records are identical across endpoints and methods. Group and Local denote group coverage and local positive-SHAP coverage; $A$ denotes Tree direct support. Events are failures to recover the reference or disagreements with the proposal.

label: tab:equal-fact-check
caption: Accuracy differences between original selections in equal-fact-count matched subgroups at the 25\% budget, using Representation and full-input-correct records. Differences are left minus right in percentage points; marginal 95\% intervals use 5,000 patient/admission bootstrap draws.

label: tab:temperature-ranking
caption: Development-temperature sensitivity under Representation. Natural rows compare local positive-SHAP coverage minus Tree $A$ in correct proposals (AP units); controlled rows compare Tree $A$ minus local positive-SHAP coverage (percentage points). Intervals are simultaneous 95\% intervals for calibrated contrasts. Original main results remain unchanged.

label: tab:source-correction-natural
caption: TRACE source-fact sensitivity: AP contrasts under Representation after reapplying eligibility to each view. Correct proposals use 614/210 original and 613/209 corrected explanations/admissions. All proposals use 962/250 and 961/249; incorrect proposals retain 348 explanations. Intervals adjust within each three-contrast stratum. All scores target the proposed diagnosis; recovery targets the reference diagnosis.

label: tab:source-correction-controlled
caption: TRACE controlled-set correction sensitivity under Representation. Values are concordance percentage-point differences, Tree $A$ minus local positive-SHAP coverage. Counts are original/corrected admissions contributing success--failure pairs. Intervals adjust across budgets.

label: tab:extra-selection
caption: Additional selection baselines under the Representation probe. Panel A uses the 25\% group budget. Panel B uses variable-size threshold/search sets and its own available population. Recovery and random-control recovery are percentages; gain intervals are pointwise percentage-point intervals.

label: tab:extra-natural
caption: Failure-detection AP for correct-proposal natural explanations under Representation. All rows within a dataset use the same available comparison records: DDXPlus has 1,979 explanations/889 patients and 20 failures; TRACE has 614 explanations/210 admissions and 105 failures. Existing scores are repeated as comparators.

label: tab:second-generator
caption: Second-generator failure-detection AP contrasts under the Representation probe. Values are AP differences with simultaneous 95\% intervals for each three-contrast family. Association and SHAP denote Association coverage and local positive-SHAP coverage; Group denotes equal-weight group coverage. Correct-proposal 4B/27B populations contain 614/635 explanations, 210/206 admissions and 105/98 failures. The 27B all-proposal and incorrect-proposal populations contain 990/355 explanations and 255/157 failures.
